```{r setup}
library(symcompR)
```

This vignette covers `sympy.liealgebras`: Cartan types, Cartan matrices,
Dynkin diagrams, root systems, and Weyl groups of the simple Lie algebras.

## Cartan types and root systems

The root systems of the simple Lie algebras are available through
`CartanType()`; Weyl groups act by reflections, and `generators()` names
the simple reflections. Roots are returned as lists of
coordinates, shown here with `sstr()`.

```{r}
ct <- CartanType("B3")
vapply(simple_root(ct, 3), sstr, "")
cartan_matrix(ct)
cartan_matrix(CartanType("G2"))
dimension(CartanType("A3"))
basis(CartanType("A2"))
length(positive_roots(CartanType("E8")))
vapply(highest_root(CartanType("A2")), sstr, "")
W <- WeylGroup("A3")
group_order(W)
generators(W)
element_order(W, "r1*r2*r3")
matrix_form(WeylGroup("A2"), "r1*r2")
group_name(WeylGroup("B2"))
```


`CartanMatrix()` and `DynkinDiagram()` accept a type given as a string or
as a list of a series letter and a rank. `cartan_rank()` is the rank and
`lie_algebra()` the name of the classical Lie algebra.

```{r}
CartanMatrix(list("G", 2))
cat(DynkinDiagram(list("B", 3)), "\n")
cat(dynkin_diagram(CartanType("F4")), "\n")
cartan_rank(CartanType("E7"))
lie_algebra(CartanType("C4"))
lie_algebra(CartanType("A3"))
basic_root(CartanType("A3"), 1, 3)
```

`RootSystem()` gives access to the simple roots, to all roots, and to sums
of roots.
`add_simple_roots()` adds two simple roots and `add_as_roots()` adds two
roots, returning the sum only when it is again a root.

```{r}
rs <- RootSystem("B2")
simple_roots(rs)
root_space(rs)
vapply(all_roots(rs), function(v) paste(vapply(v, sstr, ""), collapse = ", "), "")
add_simple_roots(rs, 1, 2)
add_as_roots(RootSystem("A3"), c(1, 0, -1, 0), c(0, 0, 1, -1))
```

## Weyl groups

`coxeter_diagram()` draws the Coxeter diagram of a Weyl group, and
`delete_doubles()` cancels repeated adjacent reflections in a word.

```{r}
cat(coxeter_diagram(WeylGroup("B2")), "\n")
delete_doubles(WeylGroup("G2"), c("1", "1", "2", "1", "2", "2"))
```
